aggregation_semantics: not aggregable; one identifier per molecule
validation: molecule.molecule_id is the primary key; 343 rows, no NULLs, no duplicates (ev_001, ev_005). Distinct values observed from TR000 to TR501 with gaps.

semantic_filter: Only molecules that have a row in the molecule table carry a label; the 101 molecule identifiers present only in atom and bond have no label.
aggregation_semantics: categorical; aggregate by counting molecules per label value rather than by arithmetic on the symbol
validation: 343 rows, 0 NULL, exactly two distinct values '+' (152) and '-' (191) (ev_002, ev_005).

aggregation_semantics: count of atom rows; sum of element-presence flags per atom
validation: atom.atom_id is the primary key; 12333 rows, no NULLs, no duplicate rows, and no duplicate (atom_id, molecule_id, element) triples (ev_001, ev_005, ev_014).

aggregation_semantics: grouping key: groups atom rows into their owning molecule
grain: one row per atom occurrence, referencing one molecule
validation: 12333 rows, 0 NULL, 444 distinct values. Its value domain is wider than molecule.molecule_id (343 values): 101 identifiers exist only here (ev_008, ev_014).

aggregation_semantics: grouping key: groups bond rows into their owning molecule
grain: one row per bond, referencing one molecule
validation: 12379 rows, 0 NULL, 444 distinct values, the same 444-value domain as atom.molecule_id (ev_008, ev_010).

aggregation_semantics: count of atoms per element symbol; count of distinct molecules per element symbol
grain: one element symbol per atom occurrence
validation: 12333 rows, 0 NULL, 21 distinct lower-case symbols (h, c, o, n, cl, s, br, na, p, f, i, si, sn, cu, zn, y, te, pb, k, ca, b) (ev_003, ev_005).

grain: one row per hydrogen atom occurrence
validation: 5518 atom rows across 426 distinct molecules carry element 'h' (ev_003).

grain: one row per heavy atom occurrence
validation: 6815 of 12333 atom rows are non-hydrogen; 2123 of them belong to '+'-labelled molecules and 2954 to '-'-labelled molecules (ev_015, ev_012).

aggregation_semantics: count of bond rows; count of bonds per bond type
validation: bond.bond_id is the primary key; 12379 rows, no NULLs, no duplicate rows (ev_001, ev_005, ev_014).
12379 rows: '-' 10528, '=' 1844, '#' 6, and 1 row with NULL bond_type (bond_id TR345_7_10) (ev_004, ev_005).

aggregation_semantics: counting adjacency entries counts each bond twice because both directions are stored; each bond_id occurs exactly twice
grain: one row per directed adjacency entry; exactly two rows per bond
validation: 24758 rows for 12379 bonds = exactly 2 per bond; both atom_id and atom_id2 resolve to atom rows; no self-pairs where atom_id equals atom_id2 (ev_009, ev_010).

aggregation_semantics: count of distinct neighbours of each atom across the adjacency entries; the count is per atom and is not stored anywhere as a column
validation: derivable from connected; 49 atoms have no adjacency entry at all and therefore degree zero (ev_009, ev_011).

aggregation_semantics: count of atom rows grouped by molecule
grain: one value per molecule (per distinct atom.molecule_id)
validation: per-molecule atom counts range from 4 to 174 with mean 27.78; TR338 has the maximum of 174 (ev_013).

aggregation_semantics: count of bond rows grouped by molecule
grain: one value per molecule (per distinct bond.molecule_id)
validation: per-molecule bond counts range from 2 to 175 with mean 27.88; every molecule has at least one bond (ev_013).
